==Biography==
===Season 2===
Liu '''"Zzitai"''' Zhi-Hao originally played in Season 2 for [[TM.Origin]] and [[AgFox]] before joining [[Invictus Gaming]] in April of 2012. Zzitai played for IG in the [[Season 2/Regional Finals - Shanghai|Season 2 China Regional Finals]] where they qualified for the [[Season 2 World Championship]] as the second seed from China by beating [[Noah's Ark]] 2-0 in the finals. At worlds, they made it through the group stage, only to fall 2-0 to [[Moscow Five]] in the quarterfinals.

===Season 3===
IG participated in the [[2013 LPL Spring/Regular Season|2013 LPL Spring Regular Season]] and managed to place first overall. However in the [[2013 LPL Spring/Playoffs|2013 LPL Spring Playoffs]], they placed third after losing 2-0 to [[Positive Energy]] but beating [[Team WE]] 2-1 in the third place match. Next, they attended [[IEM Season VIII - Shanghai]] and finished in second after they lost 2-0 in the finals to WE. In the [[2013 LPL Summer/Regular Season|2013 LPL Summer Regular Season]], they ended in fifth place and missed the playoffs. Their result in the Spring Season still qualified them for the [[Season 3 China Regional Finals]]. They ended in third after losing 2-1 to [[Royal Club Huang Zu]] in the second round of the loser's bracket. Their last tournament of the year was [[IEM Season VIII - Singapore]] and they actually managed to win the tournament by beating [[CJ Entus Frost]] 2-0 in the finals.

===2014 Season===
The new season began for Zzitai and IG at [[Demacia Cup/Season 1|Demacia Cup Season 1]]. They made it to the finals and placed first after beating WE 3-2. A few months later, they attended the [[IEM Season VIII - World Championship]] but failed to make it past groups after losing to the [[KT Rolster Bullets]] and [[Fnatic]]. The [[2014 LPL Spring/Regular Season|2014 LPL Spring Regular Season]] ended shortly afterwards with IG in fourth place. IG qualified for the [[2014 LPL Spring/Playoffs|2014 LPL Spring Playoffs]] and even made it to the finals but they lost 3-0 to [[EDward Gaming]]. They later lost 2-0 in [[Demacia Cup/Season 2|Demacia Cup Season 2]] in the round of 16 to [[Star Horn Royal Club]]. IG faired very poorly in the [[2014 LPL Summer/Regular Season|2014 LPL Summer Regular Season]], finishing in sixth place. They still qualified for the [[2014 Season China Regional Finals]] but they finished in last after losing 2-0 to [[OMG]] and 2-1 to [[LGD Gaming]].

===2015 Season===
With [[Rookie]] joining as the new mid laner for IG and [[Pokemon]] underperforming heavily, Zzitai was moved to top lane as the new starter. Zzitai played in his new position in the [[2015 Demacia Cup/Spring Season|2015 Demacia Cup Spring Season]] where IG managed to make it to the finals but they lost 3-0 to EDG. A few weeks later, they finished in fifth place in the [[2015 LPL/Spring/Regular Season|2015 LPL Spring Regular Season]] and qualified for the [[2015 LPL/Spring/Playoffs|2015 LPL Spring Playoffs]]. Here, IG ended in third place after losing 3-0 to EDG in the semifinals but beating [[Snake eSports]] 3-1 in the third place match. IG participated in the [[2015 Demacia Cup/Summer Season|2015 Demacia Cup Summer Season]] and ended in fourth after losing 3-1 to EDG and 3-2 to Snake. Back in the [[2015 LPL/Summer/Regular Season|2015 LPL Summer Regular Season]], IG ended in third place to qualify for the [[2015 LPL/Summer/Playoffs|2015 LPL Summer Playoffs]]. Here, IG finished in third place again after losing 3-2 to the [[Qiao Gu Reapers]] but beating EDG 3-1. IG qualified for the [[2015 Season China Regional Finals]] and managed to qualify for the [[2015 Season World Championship]] by beating Qiao Gu 3-0. IG was placed in a group alongside [[Cloud9]], Fnatic, and [[AHQ e-Sports Club]]. Despite being favorites to advance, they ended with a 2-4 record and were knocked out of the tournament in last place in their group.
===2016 Season===

The 2016 season was fairly straightforward for IG. The team placed 4th in the [[LPL/2016_Season/Spring_Season|2016 LPL Spring Season]] with an 8-8 record. They were quickly knocked out of playoffs in the first round after getting swept 0-3 by Snake Esports. The [[LPL/2016_Season/Summer_Season|summer season]] was identical to the spring one for IG since they finished in 4th again with a 5-11 record. The [[LPL/2016_Season/Summer_Playoffs|summer playoffs]] also had the same result and IG were knocked out in the first round again by getting swept by I May. Zzitai left IG after being on the team since 2012 and joined [[Snake Esports]] in December of 2016.

===2017 Season===

Snake's 2017 Season was even worse than the previous year. They finished the [[LPL/2017_Season/Spring_Season|2017 LPL Spring Season]] 5th place in their group and had to attend the Promotion Tournament. They defeated [[Vici Gaming]] 3-0 to keep their LPL spot. Their [[Demacia Cup/2017 Season|2017 Demacia Cup]] performance wasn't very good as well and they finished 13th-20th after a 1-2 loss to [[Red Wolf Gaming]]. In the [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Season|Summer Season]] Snake finished 4th in their group and barely made the playoffs. They however lost 0-3 to [[Newbee]] in the first round and were quickly eliminated which ended their 2017 season.

== Trivia ==
* Known for playing unorthodox middle lane champions, including bruisers such as {{ci|Jayce}} and {{ci|Lee Sin}}.
* His favorite champion is {{ci|Mordekaiser}}.<ref>[http://dt.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/zwf9i/interview_with_team_ig_from_chinaaggression_is/ iG Team Interview] ''reddit.com''</ref>
* A very versatile player. He often switches roles with [[Kid]] while also maintaining a very diverse champion pool in the mid lane.
* Due to there being no minimum age for a professional player at the beginning of his career, he was only 15 years old when he played at [[Worlds 2012]]. 
* He and [[Kid]] was the duo had played most games together in the LPL (279 games) (stats provided in April 2017).
** On January 26th, 2018, this stat got surpassed by [[Xiye]] and [[Mystic]].
* Reached 1,000 kills in the LPL in June 2016.
** The 5th player to reach 1,000 kills in the LPL, after [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[Cool]], [[Kid]], and [[NaMei]].
